tee EVOLUTION.title: Evolution of Halloween T-Shirt, Turnip Jack O Lantern Folklore Tee | Forget The Pumpkin
tee EVOLUTION.description:
THE EVOLUTION OF HALLOWEEN. FORGET THE PUMPKIN. IT STARTED WITH A TURNIP.
The first jack-o'-lanterns weren't pumpkins at all. In Ireland they were carved from turnips, in Scotland from swedes, and in England from mangelwurzels, still carved and carried through the lanes of Somerset on Punkie Night.
When Irish and Scottish emigrants took the custom across the Atlantic, they found the pumpkin bigger and far easier to carve, and it soon took over. This tee shows the whole family tree, from a ragged turnip-head to a dapper pumpkin in a top hat.
This is the Evolution of Halloween tee from Forget The Pumpkin by Wispling Press: the real history of the jack-o'-lantern in a bold woodcut style.
